import.help: One row per unit, service event, or historical rental. Units match by tag first, then serial number; assignments match an existing diver by email or exact name, stay display-only, and never affect current availability.

existing.gearSafety: Review equipment and dated service history. Rental history does not reserve equipment. Existing service records are kept; repeated service records are not added twice.
existing.siteSafety: Restore sites and their optional field guides together. Use the field names and units from a DiveDay export. Unknown columns must be matched before continuing; photos are restored only when this shop already holds them.
existing.failed: This file could not be reviewed or imported. Check the column mapping and source data, then try again.
existing.assignmentsUnmatched: Rental history not matched or invalid
existing.mappingRequired: Choose a different supported field for every column. Remove unwanted columns from the source file; no column is silently discarded.
existing.wrongFiles: Select one sites file and, optionally, one field-guide file. Check the file type for each upload.
existing.fileEmpty: This file has no rows to import.
existing.fileTooLarge: This file exceeds the CSV size limit. Split it into smaller files.
existing.tooManyRows: This file has too many rows. Split it into smaller files.
existing.tooManyColumns: This file has too many columns. Remove unused columns in the source file.
existing.cellTooLong: A cell is too long. Shorten it in the source file.
existing.noName: Map a column to name for the sites file.
existing.noGear: Map a column to gear_label for the equipment file.
existing.noGuide: Map the field-guide site ID and catalog slug columns.
existing.notAuthorized: Only an owner or manager can import shop data.

issues.assignment_missing_person: Add the diver’s email or full name for this rental.

issues.invalid_due_date: Enter the next service date as YYYY-MM-DD.
issues.invalid_due_dives: Enter a whole number of dives greater than zero.
issues.dives_need_date: Add the next service date when entering a dive limit.
issues.service_already_recorded: This service is already recorded. Remove the repeated row.
issues.assignment_unmatched_or_invalid: Check the diver and rental dates against existing records.
issues.assignment_already_recorded: This rental is already recorded. Remove the repeated row.
issues.invalid_max_depth: Check the maximum depth in meters against the site editor’s limits.
issues.invalid_min_depth: Enter a minimum depth from zero to the maximum depth, in meters.
issues.invalid_bottom_time: Check the whole number of bottom-time minutes against the site editor’s limits.
issues.invalid_route_zoom: Use a map zoom supported by the site editor.
issues.invalid_route_points: Check the route points against a dive site export.
issues.route_without_zoom: Add the map zoom for these route points.
issues.invalid_landmarks: Check the landmarks and their photos against a dive site export.
issues.invalid_image_urls: Use photo links from this shop’s dive site export.
issues.too_many_images: Reduce the photos to the site editor’s limit.
issues.unknown_difficulty: Use a difficulty value from a dive site export.
issues.unknown_tide_preference: Use a tide preference from a dive site export.
issues.foreign_image_url: Use photos already held by this shop.
issues.invalid_deleted_at: Check the deletion date against a dive site export.
issues.invalid_closure: Check the closure dates and reason in the site editor.
issues.duplicate_in_file: This site appears more than once. Keep one row per site.
issues.name_taken: Another site has this name. Check the site ID and name.
issues.not_written: This site was not saved. Review its current record and try again.
issues.site_not_restored: Import the matching site successfully before its field guide.
issues.missing_dive_site_id: Add the matching dive site ID from the site export.
issues.unknown_species: Use a species identifier from the field-guide catalog.
issues.invalid_position: Enter a whole-number position of zero or greater.
issues.duplicate_species: This species is repeated for this site. Keep one entry.
issues.too_many_species: Reduce the species to the field guide’s limit.
